slots.max_density: one primary display slot below the citation workspace
slots.placement_guardrail: Never insert inside the form, citation preview, validation, copy/download controls, or explanation panel.

slots.max_density: one low-priority display slot near the bottom of the homepage
slots.placement_guardrail: Must not interrupt the user while creating or copying a citation.

slots.max_density: one guide-page display slot after the core educational answer
slots.placement_guardrail: Must not appear before the guide's main answer or within legal citation examples.

future_activation_steps: Create or approve the site in Google AdSense for the current production URL or custom domain.
Replace provider_policy.ads_txt_publisher_id with pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX and publish ads.txt from ads.txt.template.
Set only approved slot IDs active with real numeric ad_slot values.
Set ads_active to true only after a live smoke test and privacy review.
If a custom domain is adopted later, update current_live_domain, sitemap/canonical URLs, ads.txt, and AdSense site entry.
failure_behavior: If ads-config.json cannot be fetched, all revenue slots stay hidden.
If ads_active is false, all revenue slots stay hidden and no third-party script is loaded.
If the provider, client ID, or ad slot is missing or invalid, that slot stays hidden.
If an ad network fails, the citation generator remains usable.
No legal citation text, form input, or generated citation is sent to CiteJury's server because there is no backend.

ad_slot_policy.runtime_duplicate_slot_behavior: only the first DOM slot for a given ad id may render; later duplicates stay hidden

activation_blocker: Real AdSense publisher_client_id, ads_txt_publisher_id, and numeric ad_slot values are required.
